subject.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently overwriting [AI-assisted]model-selection: warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently …

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve the shipped last-match winner while warning, or may this PR intentionally switch existing duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning is a narrow bug fix, but changing which configured provider/model wins can reroute existing auth/provider behavior and needs explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve shipped winner while warning
options.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, emit a duplicate warning, and extend the warning coverage to alias-index callers.

options.title: Approve first-match precedence
options.body: Accept the behavior break only with upgrade proof, tests, and release-note context for possible provider/model rerouting.

options.title: Pause for one unified fix
options.body: Use one coherent duplicate-alias fix or replacement PR if maintainers do not want to repair this branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve shipped winner while warning
recommendation.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, emit a duplicate warning, and extend the warning coverage to alias-index callers.
